_comment: Explicit CI shard assignment for the browser suite. Every e2e/*.spec.ts must appear in exactly one group (scripts/e2e-shard.mjs enforces this in CI). Playwright's built-in --shard splits by test COUNT, which left one shard with ~4x the runtime of the others here; balance these groups by measured DURATION instead. Each shard prints its slowest spec files as GitHub notices after it runs — use those to rebalance. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (CI/CD).
